recommendations: Hydralazine and isosorbide dinitrate may be considered in patients with symptomatic HFrEF who cannot tolerate any of an ACE-I, an ARB, or ARNI (or they are contraindicated) to reduce the risk of death.

Digoxin may be considered in patients with symptomatic HFrEF in sinus rhythm despite treatment with an ACE-I (or ARNI), a beta-blocker and an MRA, to reduce the risk of hospitalization (both all-cause and HF hospitalizations).

abbreviations.HFrEF: heart failure with reduced ejection fraction

additional_notes: Class of recommendation and level of evidence labels are present (a = class of recommendation, b = level of evidence).
The ARBs with evidence in HFrEF are listed as candesartan, losartan, and valsartan.

Associated Conditions: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF)
genes.context: Referenced as 'ACE-I' (angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor) in treatment recommendations for symptomatic HFrEF (patients who cannot tolerate an ACE-I/used in combination therapy).
